text: The service reports a new login from an unrecognized device at 02:10. The owner has not confirmed it.

statement: El servicio avisa de un acceso desde un dispositivo desconocido a las 02:10; falta confirmar si fue tuyo.

text: Owner message: I recognize that login. Separate email: subscription receipt for USD 24.10.
quote: I recognize that login. Separate email: subscription receipt for USD 24.10.

text: The service agreement is changing. Details, exceptions and the effective date appear in the following section [content truncated].
